title: Middle Eastern-Style Stuffed Dates with Ouzi
description: A fusion twist on traditional stuffed dates, with a sweet and spicy kick from the ouzi.
instructions: 2. Cut a small slit in the side of each date to create a pocket.
3. Stuff each date with a pinch of luscious cheese, a sprinkle of middle eastern spice blend, and a few chopped cilantro leaves.
4. Drizzle ouzi evenly over the stuffed dates.
5. Sprinkle crushed red pepper flakes and salt to taste.
6. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the dates are caramelized.
7. Remove from oven and squeeze fresh lime juice over the top.
